subject: Rebuild the Lua module when its sources change (#5242)
reason: The change only touches Makefiles: it adds a FORCE phony target so the Lua module sub-make always runs, and -MMD dependency-file generation in src/modules/lua/Makefile so incremental builds rebuild objects when their sources change. It is a build/CI correctness fix with no change to any compiled runtime behavior, command, reply, or data path, so a clean build of the change is functionally identical to the parent and no fuzzer scenario can exercise it.
